post.text:
"Well friends, a moment we knew was coming and have prepared for -- an exciting, exhilarating moment -- has come! 

Our new model, Mythos, represents a step-change in capabilities. It's the type of model that could actually unlock new types of scientific discovery and not just augment but completely transform what small business owners and entrepreneurs can do. We really think it could unlock super powers that give people the tools to make our world fundamentally better. 

But -- as we always knew -- a model that comes with that much good, can of course, in the wrong hands, be used for bad. To be clear: this is something we've planned for! All the excitement and promise as well as the challenge of this moment were clearly on the way, so we've spent years planning for what to do. 

We want to get this model in the hands of as many as possible, as safely as possible, as quickly as possible. For the first time, because of the power, we're going to slightly recalibrate our priorities towards the safe. 

Specifically, we're paying particularly close attention to cybersecurity. You wouldn't *believe* how fast Mythos is helping us close vulnerabilities. We've found and closed 27 year old bugs and exploits that the top cybersecurity researchers in the world hadn't found. Done right, this will be the single best tool cyber defenders have ever had. 

To make sure the people who want to use this power for good have a leg up, we're giving them a head start. For at least the next month, we'll be doing a limited release with a hand-selected group of cybersecurity partners who will both be testing the model, using it for cybersecurity work, and helping us determine the final version we're going to release to the public. 

We're so excited to see what you do with Mythos. It really does represent another massive moment of change on the path to the richer, more healthy and fulfilled society we believe AI done well will usher in." 

👆the way Anthro should be talking about Mythos.
